# Carcavelos Daily Brief – 25 Nov 2026

**Solid 2.6–2.8m swell all day with clean NW winds—your best bet before it fades this afternoon.**

**Morning (05:37–11:00):** This is your window. Waves holding steady around 2.8m with 8.2s period and light NW winds under 12km/h. The sand will be groomed and glassy from 6–9am—get there early before the wind picks up. Water temp 13°C, so bring a 4/3.

**Progression:** Expect a gradual fade through midday. By 11am the wind shifts NNW and strengthens to 14km/h, creating some texture. Waves slide from 2.8m down to 2.6m by noon.

**Afternoon (12:00–16:00):** Diminishing to 2.5m with slightly choppier conditions. Still surfable, but morning had all the quality.

**Tips:** Grab a mid-length today—the size rewards turning room. Hit it 6–9am before wind and crowds. Avoid the 11am–1pm lull when conditions deteriorate fastest.
